text:
maria: FYI found plaintext DB creds in a partner chart upload to staging charts bucket (values.yaml). Looks like: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://svc_user:hunter2@staging-db:5432/appdb

samir: Oof. File path?

maria: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-y/2.0.0/values.yaml (under extra.env). I copied it to gs://sec-evidence/INC-2026-78/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

luca: CI scanning missed it because partner upload bypassed our normal publish pipeline. Need quick containment.

oncall: Initial assessment: staging-only, no prod tokens observed. Severity: medium.

security-bot: Incident opened INC-2026-78. Triage lead assigned: @samir. Follow rotation runbook.

samir: Actions: (1) restrict partner upload SA writes to charts bucket, (2) rotate DB user, (3) search for usage of svc_user across logs and connect telemetry.

luca: I'll adjust IAM and run a grep across logs: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"svc_user"' --limit 500`.

oncall: Removing roles/storage.objectCreator for partner-ci@partner.org on gs://redwood-staging-charts/* now, adding write to quarantine bucket.

devops-bot: IAM change applied at 3245681250 by oncall: partner-ci@partner.org no longer has objectCreator on staging charts.

samir: Luca, run DB rotate script. We want an ephemeral user and write new creds to Vault kv at secret/data/staging/db/svc_user_rotA. Keep old secret marked deprecated for 48h.

luca: Running: `./infra/scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh --db=staging-db --user=svc_user --to=svc_user_rotA`

maria: Also snapshot audit logs before touching wrapped blobs: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --format=json > /tmp/audit-snap.json`

samir: Check Vault for any wrapped values referencing old transit key (transit-key-main). If found we will rewrap using a temporary KMS key and then promote.

luca: Found entries: `secret/partner-y/app` contains `wrapped_blob: wrapped-abc123` referencing transit-key-main.

samir: Rewrap plan: provision rewrap key alias rewrap-temp, grant kms.decrypt to vault-service, run controlled rewrap via tools/rewrap, snapshot audits before/after, monitor for decrypt failures.

maria: I'll add telemetry alert: staging logs for `error: decrypt` and `auth failed` on DB connections.

oncall: Partner CI uploaded a new chart to quarantine; no plaintext detected in quarantine.

luca: Rotate finished at 3245681305. Vault path written secret/data/staging/db/svc_user_rotA. Canary deployed to one staging pod via ConfigSync.

devops-bot: Canary rollout triggered at 3245681320.

maria: Canary connected successfully. Monitoring 10m. No anomalies so far.

samir: After canary validation: revoke old DB creds, run rewrap utility, run full scan across partner buckets for similar patterns, and open post-incident retro + partner guidance.

oncall: Old DB user scheduled for revocation at 3245681400 if canary remains healthy.

security-bot: INC-2026-78 update: rotation done, old creds revoked, partner CI write restriction in place. Follow-ups: infra to add server-side secret scanning on ingest, partner-security to run onboarding checklist.

maria: I'll author a short partner-runbook snippet and the retro notes.

samir: Owners: maria (retro + partner runbook), luca (RBAC PR + full chart scan), oncall (confirm IAM enforcement), samir (coordinate KMS rewrap).

luca: PR up at https://git.redwood/infra/pull/801 for transient RBAC change, requesting quick review.

maria: Closing thread after retro posted.
